integrity: The complete finite exhaustive certificate is embedded as check_C5.py and uses exact integer/rational arithmetic. All approximations in the exposition are nonessential to the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the centered counting-measure maximal operator on the five-cycle at strong exponent two is classified. No claim about longer cycles, varying exponents or historical uniqueness is made.
title: The exact Hilbert norm of centered maximal averaging on the five-cycle
